name: mcp-gads

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Lists all accessible Google Ads accounts. Run this first to discover account IDs.

tools.name: get_account_currency
tools.description: Get the currency code for a Google Ads account. Run this before analyzing cost data.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

tools.name: get_account_hierarchy
tools.description: Get the MCC account tree showing manager-client relationships via customer_client resource.

customer_id.description: Manager (MCC) account ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

tools.name: execute_gaql_query
tools.description: Execute a custom GAQL query and return results as a table. Use this for any ad-hoc Google Ads Query Language query.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

tools.name: run_gaql
tools.description:
Execute any GAQL query with output format options (table, json, csv). The most powerful tool for custom Google Ads data queries.

EXAMPLE QUERIES:
  Campaign metrics:  SELECT campaign.name, metrics.clicks, metrics.impressions, metrics.cost_micros FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS
  Ad group perf:     SELECT ad_group.name, metrics.conversions, metrics.cost_micros, campaign.name FROM ad_group WHERE metrics.clicks > 100
  Keyword analysis:  SELECT keyword.text, metrics.ctr FROM keyword_view ORDER BY metrics.impressions DESC

Note: Cost values are in micros (1,000,000 = 1 unit of currency).

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

tools.name: get_gaql_help
tools.description: Get a GAQL (Google Ads Query Language) reference guide with syntax, common resources, date filters, and example queries. Call this before writing custom GAQL queries.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List valid Google Ads API resources that can be used in GAQL FROM clauses.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

tools.name: get_campaign_performance
tools.description:
Get campaign performance metrics for the specified time period.

RECOMMENDED WORKFLOW:
1. First run list_accounts() to get available account IDs
2. Then run get_account_currency() to see what currency the account uses
3. Finally run this command to get campaign performance

Note: Cost values are in micros (1,000,000 = 1 unit of currency).

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

days.description: Number of days to look back (7, 14, 30, 90, etc.)

tools.name: get_budget_utilization
tools.description: Get campaign budget amounts vs actual spend to see budget utilization. Shows whether campaigns are limited by budget.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

days.description: Number of days to look back

tools.name: get_ad_performance

Note: Cost values are in micros (1,000,000 = 1 unit of currency).

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

days.description: Number of days to look back

days.description: Number of days to look back

tools.name: generate_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Generate keyword ideas using Google Ads Keyword Planner. Seed from keywords, a domain (seed_domain), or a page URL (seed_url). Domain and URL seeds work on sites you do not own — Google returns public information only — which makes this the supported way to research a competitor's keyword surface. Note it reports the keywords Google associates with that site, not proof the advertiser is bidding on them.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

keywords.description: Comma-separated seed keywords, e.g. 'running shoes, marathon training'

seed_domain.description: Domain to seed ideas from, e.g. 'competitor.com'. Covers the whole site. Cannot be combined with keywords or seed_url

seed_url.description: Specific page URL to crawl for ideas. Can be combined with keywords. Returns nothing if the page is not crawlable — prefer seed_domain for whole-site research

page_size.description: Number of keyword ideas to return (max 50)

tools.name: get_keyword_volumes
tools.description: Get historical search volume metrics for specific keywords. Returns exact volume data (unlike generate_keyword_ideas which suggests related keywords).

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords to get exact volumes for

tools.name: get_quality_scores
tools.description: Get keyword quality scores with component breakdown (expected CTR, ad relevance, landing page experience).

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

campaign_id.description: Optional: filter to a specific campaign ID

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). Raise it to reach the long tail — e.g. when cross-referencing against Search Console data. Large values produce large responses

tools.name: get_search_terms
tools.description: Get actual search queries that triggered your ads (search term report). Shows what users are really searching for.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

days.description: Number of days to look back

campaign_id.description: Optional: filter to a specific campaign ID

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). Raise it to reach the long tail — e.g. when cross-referencing against Search Console data. Large values produce large responses

tools.name: get_search_term_insights
tools.description: Search demand categories for a campaign — the only way to see what Performance Max and Demand Gen campaigns actually matched, since those never appear in get_search_terms. Called with just campaign_id it returns categories with a bucketed monthly search_volume for each. Pass category_id (an id from a previous call) to drill into the individual search terms inside one category; search volume is not available at that level.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID. Required — the API only serves this report one campaign at a time

category_id.description: Drill into one category's individual search terms. Use an id returned by a previous call without this argument

days.description: Number of days to look back

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). Raise it to reach the long tail — e.g. when cross-referencing against Search Console data. Large values produce large responses

tools.name: get_paid_organic_search_terms
tools.description: Compare paid and organic performance for the same search queries. Shows ad clicks next to Search Console organic clicks per query, so you can spot terms you already rank for organically and may be overpaying to advertise on. Requires the Google Ads account to be linked to Search Console.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

days.description: Number of days to look back

campaign_id.description: Optional: filter to a specific campaign ID

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). Raise it to reach the long tail — e.g. when cross-referencing against Search Console data. Large values produce large responses
